_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY: independently approve targets and limits offline. Use -policy with an absolute read-only path, isolated from the web UID, and -state with a signer-private ledger. EVM chain keys are decimal chain IDs; missing chains/fee caps/daily limits DENY. max_gas_price is wei/gas; max_fee and native limits are wei. Native budgets include value plus gas_limit*fee_cap, including ERC20 fees. Existing unscoped EVM token keys share daily totals across chains; optional evm:56:native style keys scope both limits to a chain. Solana is disabled unless explicitly configured; its keys must use solana:native or solana:<case-sensitive mint>.
